column1: # Which screens each Playwright spec passes through. One row per spec: the spec path under tests/e2e, a TAB, then
# a comma-separated list of screens (a route of src/app/[locale]/, without the locale). `*` means any screen.
# A row must name EVERY screen the spec reaches, the ones it only passes through included. A screen missing from a
# row is a screen whose change does not run that spec. Running too many is only slow; running too few is the
# failure the selector exists to avoid. When unsure, list more screens, or use `*`.
# The guard (tests/e2eScreenRegistry.integration.test.ts) fails when a spec has no row, a row names no spec, a row
# names a screen that does not exist, or a spec visits a route its row leaves out. It reads the paths a spec and
# its test helpers navigate to (page.goto, route(), toHaveURL, waitForURL). It cannot see a screen reached by
# CLICKING a link, so that part of a row is yours to keep honest.
# `*` rows below are specs whose navigation the guard cannot read (a path held in a variable).
